Rational exact-arithmetic code independently checks 7 parameters, all triple cylinders and words to length 4; these finite checks corroborate but do not replace the all-parameter proof.

value.rationale: This is a quantitatively motivated, natural fixed-window ordinal encoding of a nontrivial parametric family of expanding maps. It gives an exact instance where the ordinal factor is truly Markov, yet loses a nonzero and maximal 20% fraction of intrinsic entropy through precisely one ambiguous arrow. The closed-form mixing spectrum and parameter-independent SFT support distinguish statistical and topological complexity, directly relevant to assessing ordinal symbolic-network substitutes. It is more than the already-known symmetric five-pattern count.
